It was decided that all new products from any JAMMA member will use the same pin print-out on the edge connecter. The edge connector will have 56 pin outs, 28 per side. Konami Inc. will offer a 56 to 36 pin adaptor P-C.B. available through your distributor. This new adap- tor P.C.B. will enable the new 56 pin out to adapt to Konami’s old standard 36 pin out.

CABINET INFORMATION (1) Use an upright cabinet with a big control panel having four sets of an 8-way joystick and two function buttons. (2) Four independent coin slots are also necessary.
